digest.component_or_area: CLI guide resolution and commit-trailer documentation
propositions: CLI-served author guides contain broken consumer-relative path references (e.g., review-policy.md, ../CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/commit-ticket-trailer.md) that dangle for clients without a rebar checkout
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT) has no discoverable CLI home; it is only documented in rebar verify-commit-ticket --help and nowhere else points to it
Packaged guides in src/rebar/_guides/ must repoint all internal cross-references to either rebar explain subcommands (for sibling guides) or canonical hosted GitHub URLs (for repo-only docs)
A guard test must prevent future regression by asserting no packaged guide link target is consumer-relative; only https://, http://, intra-doc anchors, and mailto: are allowed
The new commit-ticket-trailer.md guide and all referenced guides must be discoverable and resolvable offline for repo-less CLI clients
